removal_notes.existing_hydro_reeds_ba_metadata.csv: Replaced by existing_hydro_conventional_reeds_ba_metadata.csv and existing_hydro_run_of_river_reeds_ba_metadata.csv. The shared file listed every hydro region for both the conventional and run-of-river groups, with combined capacities that matched neither type, so each group requested sites that had no profile of that type.

Hourly conventional hydro capacity-factor profiles by ReEDS balancing area for weather years 2007-2013, built by build_hydro_profiles.py. Monthly capacity factor = net generation / (capacity x calendar-month hours) over generators that reported generation that month (unreported months are excluded rather than counted as zero output), with plants assigned to 'Conventional Hydroelectric' by ReEDS technology (transform_reeds_generators.py). Sites reporting at least 75% of 2007-2013 months fill gaps with their calendar-month mean; sites without usable 2007-2013 data use the same plants' 2014-2025 calendar-month means in every weather year. Monthly values are expanded to hourly and smoothed with a 1-week centered window. Every site in the matching metadata file has a complete, nonzero 8760-hour series for each weather year.
PUDL EIA-923/860 monthly generators (out_eia__monthly_generators.parquet, nightly build fetched 2026-11-24), hydro generators with prime_mover_code='HY' only.

Sites reporting at least 75% of 2007-2013 months fill gaps with their calendar-month mean; sites without usable 2007-2013 data use the same plants' 2014-2025 calendar-month means in every weather year (p32 and p108).
